title: Any MCP client checks a research question against live claims before it starts: the kb MCP server lists coord_dedup and coord.py serve answers dedup
goal: The kb MCP server lists a coord_dedup tool right after coord_wait that runs coord.py dedup with the same id-only fields (question, holder, topic, token, ttl) and returns its topic, terms, uncovered, overlaps, held, claimed and token; coord.py serve accepts dedup, so agents of any vendor on other hosts dedup against one store; a second holder's dedup of the same question on a temp store reports the first holder's overlap.

run: import json,subprocess as s,sys;m=[{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':0,'method':'initialize','params':{'protocolVersion':'2025-11-25','capabilities':{},'clientInfo':{'name':'chk','version':'1'}}},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'notifications/initialized'},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/list','params':{}}];p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py'],input=chr(10).join(json.dumps(x) for x in m)+chr(10),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,check=True);r=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()];n=[t['name'] for x in r if x.get('id')==1 for t in x['result']['tools']];print(n);sys.exit(0 if 'coord_dedup' in n and 'coord_wait' in n and n.index('coord_dedup')==n.index('coord_wait')+1 else 1)

clauses.clause: The kb MCP server lists a coord_dedup tool right after coord_wait that runs coord.py dedup with the same id-only fields (question, holder, topic, token, ttl) and returns its topic, terms, uncovered, overlaps, held, claimed and token
coord.py serve accepts dedup, so agents of any vendor on other hosts dedup against one store
a second holder's dedup of the same question on a temp store reports the first holder's overlap

notes: Plan check 2026-10-26: check 0 reads the tools/list order, check 1 calls coord_dedup over MCP twice on a temp store (KB_COORD_STORE) and reads the fields and the second holder's overlap, check 2 starts coord.py serve on a free loopback port with two planted operator keys and runs dedup through --url twice. On the base: no coord_dedup tool (checks 0-1) and serve refuses dedup as an invalid choice (check 2): premise reproduced.
